title_en: Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Comprehensively Deepening the Reform of the People's Courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Comprehensively Deepening the Reform of People's Courts

——The Fourth Five-Year Reform Outline for People's Courts (2014-2018)

Fa Fa [2015] No. 3

Since the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, an important strategic deployment has been made to further deepen the reform of the judicial system from the perspective of developing socialist democratic politics and accelerating the building of a socialist country under the rule of law. The "Decision of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Several Major Issues Concerning Comprehensively Deepening Reform" adopted at the Third Plenary Session of the 18th Central Committee determined the main tasks of advancing the construction of a rule-of-law China and deepening the reform of the judicial system. The "Decision of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Several Major Issues Concerning Comprehensively Advancing the Rule of Law" adopted at the Fourth Plenary Session of the 18th Central Committee established the construction of a socialist legal system with Chinese characteristics and the building of a socialist country under the rule of law as the overall goal of comprehensively advancing the rule of law, and proposed a series of major reform measures in areas such as scientific legislation, strict law enforcement, impartial justice, and universal compliance with the law. The judicial reform of the people's courts is now facing unprecedented major historical opportunities. To implement the spirit of the 18th National Congress and the Third and Fourth Plenary Sessions of the 18th Central Committee, and to further deepen various reforms of the people's courts, these "Opinions on Comprehensively Deepening the Reform of People's Courts" are hereby formulated and implemented as the "Fourth Five-Year Reform Outline for People's Courts (2014-2018)."

I. Overall Approach for Comprehensively Deepening the Reform of People's Courts

The overall approach for comprehensively deepening the reform of people's courts is: closely focusing on the goal of making the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case, always adhering to the main line of justice for the people and impartial justice, striving to solve deep-seated problems that affect judicial fairness and constrain judicial capacity, ensuring that people's courts independently and impartially exercise their adjudicative power in accordance with the law, continuously improving judicial credibility, promoting the modernization of the national governance system and governance capacity, and initially establishing by 2018 a socialist adjudicative power operation system with Chinese characteristics, making it an important component of the socialist legal system with Chinese characteristics, and providing strong judicial guarantees for achieving the "Two Centenary" goals and realizing the Chinese Dream of the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

II. Basic Principles for Comprehensively Deepening the Reform of People's Courts

Comprehensively deepening the reform of people's courts shall follow the following basic principles:

-- Adhere to the leadership of the Party and ensure the correct political direction. In deepening judicial reform, people's courts shall always adhere to the leadership of the Party, give full play to the leading core role of the Party in managing the overall situation and coordinating all parties, truly realize the organic unity of Party leadership, the people being the masters of the country, and the rule of law, and ensure that judicial reform always adheres to the correct political direction.

-- Respect the laws of justice and reflect the attributes of judicial power. In deepening judicial reform, people's courts shall strictly follow the operational laws of adjudicative power as the power of judgment and discretion, highlight the attribute of adjudicative power as a central power of the state, emphasize the central position of adjudication in the litigation system, and ensure that the results of reform fully reflect the characteristics of independence, neutrality, procedural nature, and finality of adjudicative power.

-- Promote reform according to law and ensure reform is steady and orderly. In deepening judicial reform, people's courts shall adhere to the Constitution and laws as the basis, base themselves on China's national conditions, advance in an orderly manner according to law, ensure that major reforms have legal basis, and promote the timely elevation of reform measures that conform to the laws of justice and requirements of impartial justice into law.

-- Adhere to overall advancement and emphasize breakthroughs in key areas. In deepening judicial reform, people's courts shall strive to solve deep-seated problems that affect judicial fairness and constrain judicial capacity, break down obstacles in systems, mechanisms, and safeguards, while also distinguishing priorities, highlighting key points, and taking a problem-oriented approach to ensure overall reform progress.

-- Strengthen top-level design and encourage local exploration and practice. In deepening judicial reform, people's courts shall strengthen top-level design, make comprehensive planning for major reform projects, focus on the systematic, holistic, and synergistic nature of reform measures, while also respecting local pioneering spirit, encourage lower-level courts to pilot reforms under the unified arrangements of the central authorities, promptly summarize pilot experiences, and promote institutional innovation.

III. Main Tasks for Comprehensively Deepening the Reform of People's Courts

(1) Establish a Judicial Jurisdiction System Appropriately Separated from Administrative Divisions

To establish a socialist adjudicative power operation system with Chinese characteristics, it is necessary to proceed from the requirements of maintaining the unity of the national legal system and reflecting judicial fairness, and explore the establishment of a judicial jurisdiction system that ensures that people's courts independently and impartially exercise their adjudicative power in accordance with the law. By the end of 2017, a scientific, reasonable, orderly connected, and fairness-guaranteed judicial jurisdiction system shall be initially formed.

1. Establish Circuit Courts of the Supreme People's Court. The Supreme People's Court shall establish circuit courts to hear major civil, commercial, and administrative cases across administrative divisions, ensuring the uniform and correct implementation of national laws. Adjust the jurisdictional hierarchy for major civil, commercial, and administrative cases across administrative divisions to achieve orderly connection with the scope of cases under the jurisdiction of the Supreme People's Court.

2. Explore the Establishment of Courts Across Administrative Divisions. Based on the principles of science, simplicity, efficiency, and facilitating the realization of judicial fairness, explore the establishment of courts across administrative divisions, forming a litigation structure where ordinary cases are accepted by courts within administrative divisions and special types of cases are accepted by courts across administrative divisions. Transform railway transport courts into courts across administrative divisions, primarily hearing cases across administrative divisions, major administrative cases, cases concerning environmental resource protection, enterprise bankruptcy, food and drug safety, and other cases susceptible to local influence, cases prosecuted by people's procuratorates across administrative divisions, and criminal and civil cases originally accepted by railway transport courts.

3. Promote the Establishment of Intellectual Property Courts. Based on the characteristics and trial needs of intellectual property cases, establish and improve special procedures, jurisdiction systems, and trial rules that conform to the laws of intellectual property case adjudication.

4. Reform the Jurisdiction System for Administrative Cases. Through upward jurisdiction transfer and designated jurisdiction, gradually realize that administrative cases susceptible to local influence are under the jurisdiction of intermediate people's courts and above. Standardize the conditions and procedures for applications for retrial of administrative cases.

5. Reform the Jurisdiction System for Maritime Cases. Further rationalize the maritime trial system. Scientifically determine the scope of jurisdiction of maritime courts, and establish a working mechanism that better conforms to the laws of maritime case adjudication.

6. Reform the Jurisdiction System for Environmental Resource Cases. Promote the construction of environmental resource trial institutions. Further improve the jurisdiction system for environmental resource cases.

7. Improve the Jurisdiction System for Public Interest Litigation. Explore the establishment of a case jurisdiction system that connects with public interest litigation initiated by procuratorial organs.

8. Continue to Promote the Reform of the Court Management System. Uniformly incorporate forestry courts and agricultural reclamation courts into the national judicial management system, rationalize the case jurisdiction mechanism, and reform the system of courts managed by departments and enterprises.

9. Reform the Military Judicial System and Mechanism. Improve the military trial system under unified leadership, safeguard national defense interests, protect the legitimate rights and interests of military personnel, and combat illegal and criminal activities according to law.

(2) Establish a Trial-Centered Litigation System

To establish a socialist adjudicative power operation system with Chinese characteristics, it is necessary to respect the laws of justice, ensure that court trials play a decisive role in protecting litigation rights, determining evidence, ascertaining facts, and rendering impartial judgments, and realize that evidence is cross-examined in court, case facts are ascertained in court, litigation opinions are presented in court, and the basis for judgment is formed in court. By the end of 2016, promote the establishment of a trial-centered litigation system, so that investigation and prosecution review activities always revolve around the trial procedure.

10. Fully Implement the Principle of Evidence-Based Adjudication. Strengthen the awareness of the trial as the center, implement the principle of directness and orality, strictly implement the system requiring witnesses and expert evaluators to appear in court, and give full play to the role of trial in constraining and guiding investigation and prosecution procedures. Resolutely implement the principle of acquittal for doubt, strictly enforce the rule of excluding illegally obtained evidence, and further clarify the scope and exclusion procedures of illegal evidence.

11. Strengthen the Judicial Protection Mechanism for Human Rights. Manifest modern judicial civilization, prohibit criminal suspects in custody or appellants from appearing in court wearing identification uniforms, vests, prison uniforms, or other clothing bearing the marks of regulatory institutions. Strengthen institutional guarantees for the rights of parties and other litigation participants to be informed, to make statements, to defend and debate, to apply, and to appeal during litigation. Improve the mechanism for safeguarding lawyers' practice rights, strengthen the concept of equality between prosecution and defense, prohibit discriminatory security checks against lawyers, and provide convenience for lawyers to perform their duties according to law. Guarantee in accordance with the law lawyers' exercise of litigation rights such as questioning, cross-examination, and debate in court. Improve judicial supervision over judicial measures and investigative methods that restrict personal freedom, strengthen source prevention of extortion of confessions by torture and illegal evidence collection, and improve mechanisms for effective prevention and timely correction of wrongful convictions.

12. Improve the Mechanism for Rapid Handling of Minor Criminal Cases. Under the authorization and supervision of the legislative body, orderly promote the reform of expedited procedures for criminal cases.

13. Improve the System of Leniency for Guilty Pleas and Acceptance of Punishment in Criminal Proceedings. Clarify the litigation procedures, standards of punishment, and handling methods for cases in which the defendant voluntarily pleads guilty, voluntarily accepts punishment, and actively returns stolen goods or makes restitution, establish a diversion mechanism for cases in which the defendant pleads guilty and cases in which the defendant does not plead guilty, and optimize the allocation of judicial resources.

14. Improve the Rules of Proof in Civil Proceedings. Strengthen the dominant role of the parties in civil litigation proof, and determine the burden of proof of the parties according to law. Clarify the conditions, scope, and procedures for the people's court to collect evidence ex officio. Strictly implement the system requiring witnesses and expert evaluators to appear in court. Give full play to the core role of court cross-examination and authentication in determining case facts. Strictly apply the standard of preponderance of the evidence, and further clarify the conditions and scope for judges to exercise discretion. All evidence must be cross-examined in court before it can serve as the basis for judgment; important evidence over which the parties have significant disputes must be stated in the judgment document, along with reasons for adoption or non-adoption.

15. Establish a Mechanism for Full Audio and Video Recording of Court Trials. Strengthen the construction of technology courts, and promote full synchronous audio and video recording of court trials. Establish a system for the management, use, and storage of court trial audio and video recordings. Standardize the scope and procedures for live broadcasting of trials through text, images, and video.

16. Standardize Judicial Procedures for Handling Property Involved in Cases. Clarify the standards, scope, and procedures for people's courts to handle property involved in cases. Further standardize judicial procedures for sealing, seizing, freezing, and handling property involved in criminal, civil, and administrative litigation. Promote the establishment of a centralized information platform for managing property involved in cases, and improve the mechanism for disclosing information on property involved in cases.

(3) Optimize the Internal Allocation of Functions and Powers within People's Courts

To establish a socialist adjudicative power operation system with Chinese characteristics, it is necessary to optimize the internal allocation of functions and powers within people's courts, improve the mechanisms of mutual constraint and mutual connection among the stages of case filing, trial, execution, and trial supervision, give full play to the different functions of first instance, second instance, and retrial, and ensure the independence of trial levels. By the end of 2016, form a model of court function and power allocation that is scientifically positioned, clearly defined, and operates effectively.

17. Reform the Case Acceptance System. Change the case filing examination system to a case filing registration system, ensuring that cases that should be accepted by the people's court according to law are filed without exception, protecting the parties' right of action. Increase the online disclosure of case filing information. Promote the improvement of the litigation fee system.

18. Improve the Case Assignment System. On the basis of strengthening the construction of specialized collegial panels, implement a case assignment system with random assignment as the main method and designated assignment as a supplement. Establish an internal disclosure system for case assignment. When changing the trial organization or the judge in charge, reasons shall be provided and disclosed.

19. Improve the Trial Level System. Further reform the level jurisdiction system for civil and commercial cases, scientifically determine the scope of cases under the jurisdiction of basic people's courts, and gradually change the practice of mainly determining the level jurisdiction of cases based on the amount in dispute. Improve the system for upward transfer of jurisdiction, clarify the conditions, scope, and procedures for the transfer of jurisdiction of first-instance cases from lower courts to higher courts. Promote the realization that first instance focuses on ascertaining facts and applying law, second instance focuses on resolving factual and legal disputes and achieving finality of second instance, and retrial focuses on correcting errors according to law and maintaining the authority of judgments.

20. Strengthen Supervision Between Trial Levels. Strictly regulate the conditions and number of times higher courts remand cases for retrial or designate retrials, improve the mechanism for public disclosure and explanation of documents of remand and designated retrial, and the mechanism for case information feedback. When handling cases of second instance, trial by review, application for retrial, and appeal, people's courts shall point out problems in the first instance or original trial in the judgment document and explain the reasoning. When handling appealed cases that have been docketed for review, people's courts shall issue a case closing document in the statutory form to the parties; if conditions for disclosure are met, they shall be published on the China Judgments Online website.

21. Improve the Case Quality Evaluation System. Establish a scientific and reasonable case quality evaluation system. Abolish evaluation indicators and measures that violate the laws of justice, cancel any form of ranking or ordering. Strengthen the initiation of cases within the statutory period and the conclusion of cases within the normal trial period, establish a notification mechanism for long-pending cases, and resolutely stop the wrong practice of artificially controlling the acceptance and conclusion of cases. Relying on the three major platforms of trial procedure disclosure, judgment document disclosure, and enforcement information disclosure, give full play to the role of the case quality evaluation system in serving, researching, and guiding the impartial justice of people's courts.

22. Deepen the Reform of Judicial Statistics. Guided by the concept of "big data, big pattern, big service," reform the management system of judicial statistics, create a classification-scientific and information-comprehensive judicial statistics standard system, gradually build empirical analysis models that conform to trial reality and judicial laws, establish a national database of judgment documents of courts and a national big data center for judicial information of courts.

23. Improve the Mechanism for Uniform Application of Law. Improve the trial guidance methods of the Supreme People's Court, strengthen the standardization, timeliness, pertinence, and effectiveness of judicial interpretations and other trial guidance methods. Reform and improve the mechanism for screening, evaluating, and publishing guiding cases. Improve and perfect the working mechanism to ensure the uniform application of law by people's courts.

24. Deepen the Reform of the Enforcement System. Promote the pilot reform of the system for separating adjudicative power and enforcement power. Establish a legal system for credit supervision, deterrence, and punishment of dishonest persons subject to enforcement. Increase the reform of judicial auction methods, focusing on promoting the model of online judicial auctions. Improve the system for enforcing property-related penalties, promoting the incorporation of the enforcement of property-related penalties into a unified penal enforcement system.

25. Promote the Improvement of the Judicial Aid System. Clarify the conditions, standards, and scope of judicial aid, standardize the procedures for accepting, reviewing, and deciding judicial aid, and strictly manage the use of funds. Promote legislation on state judicial aid, and effectively play the positive role of judicial aid in helping the masses and resolving conflicts.

26. Deepen Interregional and International Cooperation in the Judicial Field. Promote the improvement of the judicial assistance system, expand the coverage of interregional and international judicial assistance. Promote the enactment of a law on criminal judicial assistance.

(4) Improve the Operational Mechanism of Adjudicative Power

To establish a socialist adjudicative power operation system with Chinese characteristics, it is necessary to strictly follow the laws of justice, improve the operational mechanism of adjudicative power with adjudicative power as the core and adjudicative supervision power and adjudicative management power as safeguards, implement the adjudication responsibility system, and ensure that those who hear the case make the judgment, and those who make the judgment bear the responsibility. By the end of 2015, improve and perfect an adjudicative power operational mechanism with clear rights and responsibilities, unified rights and responsibilities, orderly supervision, and complete supporting measures.

27. Improve the Case Handling Mechanism of Presiding Judges and Collegial Panels. Select adjudicative personnel with good political quality, strong case handling ability, high professional level, and rich judicial experience to serve as presiding judges. In sole-judge trials, the presiding judge is the core, with a necessary number of judicial support personnel. In collegial panel trials, the presiding judge serves as the chief judge. If all members of the collegial panel are presiding judges, the presiding judge handling the case shall, in principle, serve as the chief judge. Improve the working mechanism for presidents of courts, division chiefs, and members of the adjudicative committee to serve as chief judges and participate in collegial panel trials. Reform and improve the working mechanism of collegial panels, clarify the scope of functions of collegial panels as trial organizations, and improve the mechanism for joint participation and mutual supervision among collegial panel members in the stages of cross-review of files, trial, and deliberation. Reform the mechanism for signing and issuing judgment documents.

28. Improve the Responsibility System for Presiding Judges and Collegial Panels in Handling Cases. In accordance with the principle of unifying powers, responsibilities, and interests, clarify the case-handling responsibilities and conditions for exemption from liability of presiding judges, collegial panels, and their members, achieving effective connection among evaluation mechanisms, accountability mechanisms, disciplinary mechanisms, withdrawal mechanisms, and safeguard mechanisms. When a presiding judge participates in a collegial panel as the chief judge, the presiding judge has equal powers with other collegial panel members, but bears positional responsibilities such as presiding over trial activities, controlling the trial process, organizing panel deliberation, and avoiding procedural defects. Scientifically define the responsibilities of collegial panel members, ensuring both their independent expression of opinions and clarifying their personal opinions and the responsibility of their conduct in the outcome of the case.

29. Improve the Trial Management Mechanism for Court Presidents and Division Chiefs. Clarify the trial management duties of court presidents and division chiefs commensurate with their positions. Standardize the review and approval system for changes in case proceedings and changes in trial deadlines. Improve the internal supervision mechanism for classified archiving of litigation files, online case handling, trial process control, and online publication of judgment documents.

30. Improve the Trial Supervision Mechanism for Court Presidents and Division Chiefs. Clarify the trial supervision duties of court presidents and division chiefs commensurate with their positions, and improve the internal constraint and supervision mechanism. Improve the mechanisms of presiding judges' meetings and professional judges' meetings. Standardize the supervision mechanism of court presidents and division chiefs over major, difficult, and complex cases, and establish a system for archiving all documents formed by court presidents and division chiefs in the course of supervision activities. Relying on modern information technology, establish a mechanism for full traceability, mutual supervision, and mutual constraint between the exercise of adjudicative power by presiding judges and collegial panels and the exercise of supervisory power by court presidents and division chiefs, ensuring that supervision is not absent, not overstepped, leaves traces, and that dereliction of duty is held accountable.

31. Improve the Trial Management System. Give full play to the role of trial management in guaranteeing, promoting, and serving the improvement of trial quality and efficiency, standardizing judicial conduct, strictly following litigation procedures, and unifying the standards of judgment, strengthen the management of key nodes in the trial process, and further improve the work of case quality evaluation.

32. Reform the Working Mechanism of the Adjudicative Committee. Reasonably position the functions of the adjudicative committee, strengthen the macro-guidance function of the adjudicative committee in summarizing trial experience and discussing and deciding major matters of trial work. Establish a pre-screening mechanism for matters to be discussed by the adjudicative committee, and standardize the scope of cases discussed by the adjudicative committee. Except for circumstances prescribed by law and major complex cases involving national diplomacy, security, and social stability, the adjudicative committee shall mainly discuss issues of legal application in cases. Improve the rules of procedure of the adjudicative committee, establish a system for signing and confirming meeting materials and minutes of adjudicative committee meetings. Establish a system for follow-up supervision, response, and public disclosure of matters decided by the adjudicative committee. Establish a mechanism for evaluating the performance of adjudicative committee members and internal disclosure.

33. Promote the Reform of the People's Assessor System. Implement the "doubling plan" for people's assessors, broaden the channels and scope for selecting people's assessors, ensure the participation of the people in justice, and ensure that the proportion of grassroots people is no less than two-thirds of newly added people's assessors. Further standardize the selection conditions for people's assessors, reform the selection method, and improve the exit mechanism. Clarify the powers of people's assessors in participating in trials, and improve the random selection mechanism. Reform the mode of participation, gradually implementing that people's assessors no longer review issues of legal application but only participate in determining issues of fact. Strengthen the financial guarantee for people's assessors to perform their duties according to law. Establish a dynamic management mechanism for people's assessors.

34. Reform of reasoning in adjudicatory documents. Achieve a differentiated approach to the complexity of adjudicatory documents based on different trial levels and case types. Strengthen the reasoning in adjudicatory documents for first-instance cases where the parties have significant disputes, the legal relationship is complex, or there is high public concern, as well as for all second-instance cases, retrial cases, and cases decided by the adjudicatory committee. For first-instance civil and commercial cases where the facts are clear, rights and obligations are clearly defined, and the parties have little dispute, and for first-instance minor criminal cases where the facts are clear, the evidence is reliable and sufficient, and the defendant pleads guilty, use simplified adjudicatory documents; improve adjudicatory efficiency by filling in essential elements and simplifying the format. Pay attention to defense and representation opinions; if defense or representation opinions legally submitted by lawyers are not adopted, the reasons shall be stated in the adjudicatory document. Improve the rigid constraint mechanism and incentive mechanism for reasoning in adjudicatory documents, establish an evaluation system for such reasoning, and take the level of reasoning in adjudicatory documents as an important factor in judge performance evaluation, promotion, and selection for advancement.

35. Improve judicial integrity and supervision mechanisms. Improve and strengthen judicial inspections, trial supervision inspections, and the work of integrity supervisors. Establish a mechanism for investigating and handling disciplinary violation cases with the higher-level disciplinary inspection commission and the higher-level court as the main bodies, and the lower-level court coordinating and cooperating, ensuring an orderly connection between disciplinary inspection and supervision procedures and judge disciplinary procedures. Establish a recording system and accountability system for internal court personnel inquiring about cases. Legally regulate the contacts and interactions between court personnel and parties, lawyers, special relationship persons, and intermediary organizations.

36. Reform the petition system related to litigation. Improve the working mechanism for separating petitions and litigation, clarifying the standards, scope, and procedures for separation. Improve the termination mechanism for litigation-related petitions, legally regulating the order of such petitions. Establish an on-site reception and supervision mechanism, and innovate the online processing mechanism for petitions. Promote the establishment of a lawyer representation system for retrial cases. Explore the establishment of a mechanism for third-party social participation to enhance the joint resolution of multiple disputes in litigation-related petitions.

(5) Build an open, dynamic, transparent, and convenient sunshine judicial mechanism

To establish a socialist judicial power operation system with Chinese characteristics, it is necessary to rely on modern information technology to build an open, dynamic, transparent, and convenient sunshine judicial mechanism, enhancing public understanding, trust, and supervision of the judiciary. By the end of 2015, form three comprehensive, complete, and convenient platforms for the disclosure of trial procedures, adjudicatory documents, and enforcement information of the People's Courts, and establish a comprehensive, systematic, scientific, and convenient mechanism for justice for the people.

37. Improve the trial openness system. Establish a system for the publication and reservation of trial announcements and information on seats for observers. For cases that should be openly tried according to law and are of social concern, the People's Court shall, within existing conditions, give priority to arranging court sessions with a number of seats appropriate to the number of applicants for observation. Qualified trial courts shall set up media observer seats to give priority to meeting the observation needs of news media.

38. Improve the trial procedure disclosure platform. Promote the construction of government websites of courts nationwide. Establish a unified online service platform for litigation announcements and a litigation announcement website for courts nationwide. Continue to strengthen the construction of the China Trial Procedure Information Disclosure Network website, improve the mechanism for timely aggregation and real-time updates of trial information data. Accelerate the construction of the electronic archive project for litigation files. Promote the disclosure of trial procedure information by courts nationwide on the same platform, facilitating parties to obtain online information on trial procedure milestones from the date of case acceptance.

39. Improve the adjudicatory document disclosure platform. Strengthen the construction of the China Judgments Online website, improve its search and retrieval functions and information aggregation functions, facilitating the public to effectively obtain, access, and copy adjudicatory documents. Strictly follow the requirement of "disclosure as the principle, non-disclosure as the exception," and achieve the unified publication of effective adjudicatory documents that should be disclosed according to law by the four-level People's Courts on China Judgments Online.

40. Improve the enforcement information disclosure platform. Integrate various types of enforcement information, promote the unified disclosure of enforcement information by courts nationwide on the same platform, facilitating parties to understand the progress of enforcement work online. Strengthen the publication of information on the list of dishonest judgment debtors, fully leveraging their credit punishment effect to prompt judgment debtors to voluntarily perform effective legal documents. Improve the construction of the judgment debtor information disclosure system, facilitating the public to understand enforcement work and actively accept social supervision.

41. Improve the openness system for commutation, parole, and temporary service of sentence outside prison. Improve the applicable conditions and case handling procedures for commutation, parole, and temporary service of sentence outside prison, ensuring that relevant cases are handled openly and fairly. Cooperate with penal enforcement agencies and procuratorial organs to promote the construction of an online collaborative case handling platform, implementing online entry, information sharing, and full-process traceability for important matters and key links in law enforcement, case handling, assessment, rewards, and punishments, ensuring supervision from both institutional and technical perspectives. Establish an information network for commutation, parole, and temporary service of sentence outside prison, achieving unified online disclosure of case filing announcements, trial announcements, and document publication for the three types of cases.

42. Establish a judicial openness supervision system. Strengthen public supervision of judicial openness work, improve the complaint mechanism and relief channels for violations of judicial openness regulations. Fully leverage the supervisory functions of the three major platforms for judicial openness, making the opinions and suggestions raised by the public through the platforms important references for the People's Courts in trial management, trial supervision, and work improvement.

43. Improve the litigation service center system. Strengthen the standardized construction of litigation service centers, improve litigation service halls, online litigation service platforms, and the 12368 judicial service hotline. Establish working mechanisms for online appointment for case filing, service of documents, announcements, and appeals. Promote video applications such as remote mediation and petitions, further expanding the breadth and depth of justice for the people.

44. Improve the people's tribunal system. Optimize the regional layout and personnel ratio of people's tribunals. Actively promote a tribunal layout form with central tribunals as the main body, supplemented by community tribunals and巡回 trial points. According to the actual conditions of the jurisdiction, improve the convenient case-filing mechanism of people's tribunals. Optimize the personnel composition of people's tribunals. Orderly promote personnel exchanges between people's tribunals and between people's tribunals and other divisions of the grassroots People's Court.

45. Promote reform of the service of documents system. Promote the establishment of a binding mechanism where parties confirm the address for service of documents and bear corresponding legal consequences; explore and promote electronic service methods under information-based conditions to improve service efficiency.

46. Improve the diversified dispute resolution mechanism. Continue to promote the organic connection and mutual coordination of dispute resolution mechanisms such as mediation, arbitration, administrative adjudication, and administrative reconsideration with litigation, guiding parties to choose appropriate dispute resolution methods. Promote the construction of industry-specific and professional dispute resolution organizations in areas such as land acquisition and demolition, environmental protection, labor protection, medical and health, traffic accidents, property management, and insurance disputes; promote the improvement of the arbitration system and administrative adjudication system. Establish a joint working system for people's mediation, administrative mediation, industry mediation, commercial mediation, and judicial mediation. Promote the legislative process for diversified dispute resolution mechanisms, constructing a systematic and scientific diversified dispute resolution system.

47. Promote the implementation of a legal popularization responsibility system. Strengthen the court's awareness of legal popularization, fully leverage the legal popularization functions of open trials, reasoning in documents, and case publication, promoting the high degree of unity between the People's Courts' exercise of adjudicatory functions and the fulfillment of legal popularization responsibilities.

(6) Promote the regularization, specialization, and professionalization of court personnel

To establish a socialist judicial power operation system with Chinese characteristics, it is necessary to adhere to the adjudication-centered and judge-focused approach, comprehensively promote the regularization, specialization, and professionalization of court personnel, and strive to enhance professional competence and expertise. By the end of 2017, initially establish a court personnel management system with scientific classification, clear division of labor, reasonable structure, and conformity with the characteristics of the judicial profession.

48. Promote reform of the court personnel classification management system. Establish a separate job sequence for judges that conforms to professional characteristics. Improve the management system for judicial auxiliary personnel such as judge assistants, court clerks, and enforcement officers. Scientifically determine the ratio of judges to judicial auxiliary personnel, establish a normal recruitment mechanism for judicial auxiliary personnel, and effectively reduce judges' workload of administrative tasks. Broaden the sources of judicial auxiliary personnel, explore the optimization of the structure of judicial auxiliary personnel through the purchase of social services. Explore and promote reform of the judicial police management system. Improve the management system for judicial administrative personnel.

49. Establish a judge quota system. Scientifically determine the judge quotas for the four-level courts based on basic data such as the economic and social development status of the court's jurisdiction, population (including temporary residents), number of cases, and case types, combined with factors such as the court's trial level functions, judge workload, configuration of judicial auxiliary personnel, and case handling support conditions. Improve the dynamic adjustment mechanism for judge quotas based on changes in case numbers and personnel structure. Scientifically set a transition plan for the reform of the judge quota system, comprehensively considering factors such as trial performance, professional ability, theoretical level, and legal work experience, ensuring that outstanding judges remain on the trial frontline.

50. Reform the judge selection system. Set different judge qualification conditions for courts at different levels. Establish judge selection committees composed of judge representatives and relevant social personnel at the national and provincial levels respectively, formulate open, fair, and just selection procedures, ensure that outstanding legal talents with integrity, experience, and high professional standards become candidates for judges, and achieve effective connection between the judge selection mechanism and the statutory appointment and removal mechanism. Improve the mechanism for unified recruitment of newly appointed judges by Higher People's Courts and their assignment to grassroots People's Courts. Cooperate with the reform of the unified pre-service training system for legal professionals, improve the training system for预备 judges. Appropriately raise the minimum age for newly appointed judges. Establish a mechanism whereby judges of higher-level courts are原则上 selected from lower-level courts. Improve the system for selecting outstanding lawyers, legal scholars, and professional legal talents serving in legislative, procuratorial, law enforcement, and other departments as judges. Improve the two-way exchange mechanism between courts and law schools and legal research institutions, implement plans for mutual appointment of personnel between universities and courts.

51. Improve the judge performance evaluation system. Establish a scientific, reasonable, objective, fair, and law-conforming judge performance evaluation mechanism, improve evaluation standards, and use evaluation results as important basis for judge rank promotion and merit-based selection. Establish a withdrawal mechanism for incompetent judges, and improve relevant supporting measures.

52. Improve the on-the-job training mechanism for judges. Strictly guided by actual needs, adhere to classified, tiered, and all-staff training, focusing on enhancing judges' ability to preside over trials, apply the law, and write adjudicatory documents. Improve the mechanisms for plan generation, organization and training assignment, tracking management, and quality evaluation of judge education and training; improve the database of teaching resources, case database, and high-quality courseware database. Strengthen the construction of judge training institutions and on-site teaching bases. Establish a Chinese Judge Education and Training Network, relying on information technology to vigorously promote online teaching, achieving free online sharing of high-quality teaching courseware by court personnel. Vigorously strengthen the training of judges of grassroots People's Courts and bilingual judges of ethnic minorities.

53. Improve the judge salary system. Implement the provisions of the Judges Law, research and establish a salary system matching the separate job sequence for judges.

(7) Ensure that the People's Courts independently and impartially exercise adjudicatory power according to law

To establish a socialist judicial power operation system with Chinese characteristics, it is necessary to adhere to the leadership of the Party, promote the improvement of various systems ensuring that the People's Courts independently and impartially exercise adjudicatory power according to law, optimize the judicial environment, establish judicial authority, strengthen professional guarantees, and enhance judicial credibility. By the end of 2018, promote the formation of an institutional environment and social atmosphere that trusts, respects, and supports the judiciary.

54. Promote the reform of unified management of personnel in courts below the provincial level. Cooperate with relevant central departments to promote the establishment of a unified management system for the staffing of local courts below the provincial level. Promote the establishment of a mechanism whereby judges of local courts below the provincial level are uniformly nominated and managed by the province and appointed or removed according to legal procedures.

55. Establish a working mechanism to prevent interference in judicial activities. Cooperate with relevant central departments to promote the establishment of a system for recording, reporting, and holding accountable leading cadres who interfere in trial and enforcement activities or intervene in specific case handling. According to the requirement of full-process traceability of cases, clarify the recording obligations and responsibilities of trial organizations; for instructions, official letters, records, and other information of leading cadres interfering in judicial activities or intervening in specific cases, establish a mechanism for legal extraction, media storage, specialized database entry, and filing for future reference; such information shall be stored in the main case file for access by the parties and their agents.

56. Improve the protection mechanism for judges performing their statutory duties. Rationally determine the work responsibilities, work processes, and work standards of judges and judicial auxiliary personnel. Clarify the criteria for distinguishing errors of different subjects and types and the grounds for exemption from liability, ensuring that judges are not held accountable for performing their duties according to law. Except for statutory reasons and through statutory procedures, judges shall not be transferred, dismissed, or subjected to sanctions such as removal from office or demotion. Improve the judge complaint and accusation system, establish a relief mechanism when judges' lawful rights and interests are infringed due to lawful performance of duties, and improve the mechanism for clarifying unfounded accusations. Establish judge disciplinary committees composed of judge representatives and relevant social personnel at the national and provincial levels respectively, formulate open and fair judge disciplinary procedures, ensuring both that judges' disciplinary violations are promptly and appropriately punished and that their rights to explanation, evidence submission, reconsideration, and appeal are guaranteed.

57. Improve the judicial authority guarantee mechanism. Promote the improvement of the prosecution mechanism for crimes such as refusal to enforce judgments and rulings, and contempt of court authority. Promote relevant legal amendments, legally punish acts of serious contempt of court authority such as destroying evidence materials, trial records, legal documents, and court facilities in court, as well as criminal acts such as threatening, insulting, following, harassing court personnel or their close relatives outside court.

58. Strengthen the litigation integrity guarantee mechanism. Establish litigation integrity records and punishment systems. Legally punish false litigation, malicious litigation, and unreasonable persistent litigation; include information on the above three types of acts in the social credit system. Explore the establishment of damages lawsuits for victims of false litigation and malicious litigation.

59. Optimize the external environment for administrative trials. Improve the system for heads of administrative organs to respond to lawsuits according to law, guide and regulate the participation of administrative organs in litigation activities. Regulate the preparation and issuance of judicial suggestions to promote the improvement of administrative law enforcement levels.

60. Improve the judge oath-taking system. Improve the judge oath-taking system; judges elected or appointed by People's Congresses and their standing committees at all levels shall publicly take an oath of allegiance to the Constitution when officially assuming office.

61. Improve the judicial honor system. Clarify the standards, conditions, and procedures for awarding different types of honors to judges and judicial auxiliary personnel, enhancing the sense of professional honor and belonging of court personnel.

62. Rationalize the management relationship of judicial administrative affairs in courts. Scientifically set up the judicial administrative affairs management institutions of the People's Courts, standardize and unify management responsibilities, and explore the relative separation of the management power of judicial administrative affairs and adjudicative power of courts. Improve the management mechanism of judicial administrative affairs between higher and lower courts, clarifying the supervisory functions of the judicial administrative affairs management departments of higher courts over the judicial administrative affairs of lower courts.

63. Promote the reform of the financial management system of the People's Courts. Cooperate with relevant central departments to promote the reform of the unified funding management mechanism for local courts below the provincial level. Improve the budget guarantee system, national treasury revenue and expenditure system, and financial management system of the People's Courts, and promote the construction of a long-term mechanism for the funding management and guarantee of the People's Courts. Strictly implement "separate revenue and expenditure" management; litigation fees, fines, confiscated property, and recovered stolen goods and illegal gains collected by local People's Courts at all levels shall be uniformly turned over to the provincial treasury. Strengthen the construction of venues such as courtrooms and offices. Establish an equipment standards system for the People's Courts.

64. Promote the reform of the internal institutions of the People's Courts. According to the requirements of scientific, streamlined, and efficient work, promote flat management, and gradually establish an internal institution setting model with serving trial work as the focus.

65. Promote the information technology construction of the People's Courts. Accelerate the construction of the "Balance Project", focus on integrating existing resources, and promote various information technology applications serving the work of courts and the needs of the public. The information technology coverage rate for main business of the Supreme People's Court and Higher People's Courts shall reach 100%, and for Intermediate People's Courts and Grassroots People's Courts, it shall reach over 95% and over 85% respectively.

IV. Work Requirements for Comprehensively Deepening the Reform of the People's Courts

Comprehensively deepening the reform of the People's Courts is an arduous task with heavy responsibilities and tight deadlines. People's Courts at all levels must conscientiously implement the decisions and deployments of the Central Committee, strengthen organizational leadership, improve working mechanisms, and ensure that reform measures are implemented with focus, steps, and order, achieving actual results and benefiting the entire people.

The Judicial Reform Leading Group of the Supreme People's Court is the deliberative, coordinating, and guiding body for judicial reform of the People's Courts, holding meetings irregularly to study and determine reform priorities, review reform plans, listen to progress reports, and discuss and decide on major issues.

The Supreme People's Court establishes systems for situation reporting, supervision and inspection, and evaluation and summarization, timely grasping the dynamics of reform, strengthening supervision and guidance, correcting erroneous practices, summarizing successful experiences, ensuring that every reform task is arranged, supervised, and inspected, and that all tasks are fully completed.

Each Higher People's Court shall establish a judicial reform leading group to supervise, guide, coordinate, and coordinate judicial reform work within its jurisdiction. People's Courts at all levels shall establish and improve the system of reporting for approval, filing, and requesting instructions on judicial reform matters, timely summarizing reform experiences, reporting work progress, and reflecting on problems and difficulties. If a Higher People's Court intends to pilot some reform projects, the pilot plan must be submitted to the Supreme People's Court for approval; major reform pilot plans must be submitted by the Supreme People's Court to the Central Committee for approval before implementation.
